decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 25th October 2006, the erection of a new roof extension with roof window to front of house with 3.80m projection, 1.60m high at the top not exceeding the roofline of the original house, 4.70m wide was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls inside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension has a volume of under 50cubic metres.
Condition : 2 - Informatives: 

1.	The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

2.	The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.

3.	A full planning application has been submitted to the Local Authority for the erection of a single storey rear extension. This certificate will only be valid should construction of the proposed roof extensions be completed before the construction commences on any other extension which may be approved by the Local Authority.
description: Certificate of lawfuness for the erection of rear roof extension incorporating one front roof light to the existing house.
